items.title: Mariah has defrosted
items.creator: Mariah Carey
items.body: the yearly "it's time" trend is back: people post spooky-to-christmas before-and-afters or film their first decoration going up. it's november 6!!

items.title: the "Dame Hombro" shoulder dance
items.creator: Bulin 47 & Kevin Wai
items.body: it started as a street freestyle in spain, became a real song in october, and now it's everywhere. shoulder pops, knee bends, a little shrug. very catchy.

items.title: "Paper Moon Static" is still #1
items.body: still the top sound on TikTok's worldwide chart, with over 100K new videos a day. truly came out of nowhere.

items.title: 78% of gen z want screen-free gifts
items.body: PwC's holiday survey says 78% of gen z are prioritizing screen-free gifts this year, vs 64% of everyone. board games and art supplies are winning over gadgets.

items.title: gen z actually likes going to stores
items.body: 71% of gen z say they enjoy browsing in person, vs 60% of shoppers overall. the mall is back??

items.title: gen z wants MORE office days than millennials
items.body: a Savills survey found gen z wants 3.4 office days a week, a bit more than younger millennials (3.2). and 100% of them said work-life balance matters.

items.title: gen z has the longest commutes
items.body: 46% of gen z commute 41+ minutes, the biggest share of any generation in the same Savills survey.
